bank_name.description: Name of the bank issuing the statement.

product_name.description: Name of the account product, e.g. Manulife One.

statement_period.description: Month the statement covers, as YYYY-MM.

statement_date.description: Date the statement was prepared, as YYYY-MM-DD.

account_holders.description: Every borrower or account holder named on the statement.

snapshot.description: The account snapshot on the first page, exactly as printed.

opening_total_borrowings.description: Total borrowings at the end of the previous month, in dollars.

money_in.description: Money that went into the account during the month, in dollars.

money_out.description: Money that came out of the account during the month, in dollars.

closing_total_borrowings.description: Total borrowings at the end of the month, in dollars.

reduction_in_borrowings.description: Reduction in borrowings during the month, in dollars.

interest_charges.description: Amount needed to pay the month's interest charges, in dollars.

available_limit.description: Available limit at the end of the month, in dollars.

main_account_transactions.description: Every row of the main account's transaction table, in order, excluding the opening and closing balance rows.

money_out.description: Amount in the Money out column, or null if empty.

money_in.description: Amount in the Money in column, or null if empty.

borrowings_balance.description: Running borrowings balance after the transaction, in dollars.

sub_accounts.description: Every sub-account with its own transaction table.

interest_rate.description: Borrowing interest rate for the month, as a percentage, e.g. 3.79.

interest_charged.description: Interest charged for the month, in dollars.

total_interest_charged.description: Total interest charged for the month across all accounts, in dollars.

total_interest_year_to_date.description: Total interest charged since January, across all accounts, in dollars.
